turns.text: morning. holiday but im still doing my one alum a weekday thing so need a short note to a bayshore alum who works at a freight company. asking for a 15 min chat
Happy to help. Keep it short and specific. A few things would make it land: what you want to ask about, how you want to introduce yourself, and any timing. What should I include?

i have a second round video interview with harrowgate distribution on the 18th and want an insider angle on how that kind of distribution work actually runs day to day. mention im a logistics management junior at bayshore state

Here's a draft:

Subject: Bayshore State student seeking 15 minutes of advice

Hi [Alum's name],

I'm a junior in logistics management at Bayshore State and found your profile through the alumni network. I'm preparing for a second-round interview with Harrowgate Distribution on November 18, and I'd really value an insider's view of how distribution operations work day to day.

Would you have 15 minutes in the next week for a quick call or video chat? I'm flexible and happy to work around your schedule.

Thank you for considering it, and thanks for any time you can spare.

Best,
[Your name]
[Phone/LinkedIn]

Want a shorter LinkedIn-message version too?
yes pls, linkedin has a char limit. also i see ashby thursday in office hours so id like to send this before then, he'll prob ask if ive done any outreach

Good plan, sending today gives the alum time to reply before Thursday. LinkedIn version:

Hi [Name], I'm a logistics management junior at Bayshore State prepping for a Harrowgate Distribution interview on Nov 18. Could I grab 15 minutes to hear how distribution work runs day to day? Thanks so much, [Your name]

It's short enough for most connection-request limits. If it's still too long, cut "so much" and "day to day." Want a one-line follow-up for if they don't reply in a few days?
thx, th short one is perfect
Glad it works. Good luck with the outreach and the interview on the 18th!
